segments.name: First Advantage Americas
segments.description: Performs background check and compliance services for employers across the workforce lifecycle in the United States, Canada, and Latin America.
segments.evidence: First Advantage Americas. This segment pertains to our Legacy First Advantage business and performs a variety of background check and compliance services across all phases of the workforce lifecycle from pre-onboarding services to post-onboarding and ongoing monitoring services, covering employees, contractors, contingent workers, and drivers.

segments.name: First Advantage International
segments.description: Provides background screening and compliance services to employers in Europe, India, and Asia Pacific outside the Americas.
segments.evidence: The First Advantage International segment pertains to our Legacy First Advantage business and provides services similar to our Americas segment in regions outside of the Americas.

segments.name: Sterling
segments.description: Delivers background screening and compliance services globally from the acquired Sterling business, sold to employers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Sterling segment provides similar services as compared to First Advantage's Americas and International segments on a global basis.

revenueModel.text: Employers and other customers pay per completed background screening order under contracts typically lasting three years, billed monthly.
revenueModel.evidence: We typically bill our customers at the end of each month and recognize revenues as completed orders are reported or otherwise made available to our customers.

changes.text: The 2024 Sterling acquisition added Sterling as a separate reportable segment.
changes.evidence: "Sterling" refers to Sterling Check Corp., which became an indirect, wholly owned subsidiary of First Advantage on October 31, 2024, and now operates as a separate reportable segment

changes.text: In 2023 the acquired Infinite ID business was included in the First Advantage Americas segment.
changes.evidence: Results of operations have been included in our First Advantage Americas segment from the date of the acquisition.
